name: @veridex/stellar-facilitator
description: Veridex x402 facilitator for Stellar, with Bazaar discovery and a stock-client conformance harness

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix facilitator-service ci && npm --prefix bazaar-service ci && npm --prefix demo-server ci && npm --prefix conformance ci && npm --prefix mcp-server ci && npm --prefix sdk-typescript ci && npm --prefix playground ci
scripts.install:all:nolock: npm install && npm --prefix facilitator-service install && npm --prefix bazaar-service install && npm --prefix demo-server install && npm --prefix conformance install
scripts.build: npm --prefix facilitator-service run build && npm --prefix bazaar-service run build && npm --prefix demo-server run build && npm --prefix sdk-typescript run build && npm --prefix playground run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix facilitator-service run typecheck && npm --prefix bazaar-service run typecheck && npm --prefix demo-server run typecheck && npm --prefix playground run typecheck && npm --prefix sdk-typescript run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix facilitator-service test -- --run && npm --prefix bazaar-service test -- --run && npm --prefix mcp-server test -- --run && npm --prefix sdk-typescript test -- --run
